refused.session: Your session isn’t valid here any more. Sign in again to change the language.
refused.account: This account can’t change the language here.
refused.unavailable: The language couldn’t be saved right now. Try again in a moment.
refused.rejected: That language couldn’t be saved. That’s a bug on our side, not something you did.
refused.unreachable: It isn’t clear whether the language changed. Try again in a moment.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.detail: This account doesn’t have access here. Sign in with a different account, or ask for this one to be added.

unauthenticated.title: Session refused
unauthenticated.detail: Your session isn’t valid here any more. Sign in again.

notFound.title: It isn’t there any more
notFound.detail: That couldn’t be found. Reload to see what’s actually there.

invalid.title: That couldn’t be sent
invalid.detail: The API rejected the request. That’s a bug on our side, not something you did.

conflict.title: Something’s in the way
conflict.detail: That can’t be done while things are as they are. Reload to see what changed.

auth.title: Can’t check your session
auth.detail: Your sign-in can’t be verified right now. Try again in a moment.

storage.title: Can’t reach your data
storage.detail: The service is up, but it can’t reach its database right now. Try again in a moment.

api.title: Can’t load your data
api.detail: The API isn’t answering properly right now. Reload in a moment.

boundary.heading: Something went wrong on our side
boundary.body: This screen couldn’t be drawn. That’s a bug on our side, not something you did.

notFound.heading: Not here
notFound.body: That link doesn’t point at anything: something that was deleted, or an address that never existed.

signIn.note: Sign-ups are closed. Only accounts on this deployment’s own list are admitted.

notConfigured.heading: Sign-in is not configured
notConfigured.body: Set the Clerk keys ({publishable} and {secret} in the root {env}) and restart.
